_doc: Retired tradition ids, each kept as an alias of the tradition it was merged into. Every surface that takes a tradition id resolves an alias to its surviving id first (scripts/_loader.js resolveTraditionId; the browser's copy is inlined into src/app.js by scripts/build_aliases.js), and api/traditions/<alias>.json serves the surviving record marked alias_of. An alias is never a live id, its target is always live, and a retired id is never reused. verdict: 'same' = one tradition under two names; 'slice' = an era/market/mood slice with no documented difference in sound or practice. Which record survives: for 'same', the better-documented of the two (more of its recording chain, parts, exemplars and prose authored); for 'slice', the broader entry. Evidence for each merge: docs/geographic-attribution-audit/duplicates.csv.
